json_ld.description:
We've recreated the feeling of your favorite lived-in shirt with our new Vintage Wash styles. We started with slub cotton with a naturally rich feel, then gave it a special treatment that breaks down fibers for a soft feel from the very first wear. This all-cotton shirt has a laid-back check pattern that's perfect for the weekend and warm-weather getaways alike.
 
 A Stay-Put Collar, unbreakable buttons, and single-needle side seams give this shirt a refined feel that holds up wear after wear. Designed to move seamlessly from casual days to dressed-up moments, it pairs easily with our Stretch Chino Shorts for a relaxed, confident look that always feels put-together.
 
 FEATURES 
 
 • Spread collar
 • Navy signature sail
 • SKU #42283Blu
 
 FABRICS
 
 • 100% Cotton
 • Imported
